### Ratings view

No supported rating-pressure direction, nearest trigger or transition timing can be established. The required forecast handoff is explicitly blocked and contains no calculated cases; the available source pack also lacks dated agency actions, applicable criteria and issuer-specific triggers. Historical accounting leverage cannot substitute for agency-adjusted leverage, and an investor's capital-allocation concern cannot be attributed to an agency without evidence. Accordingly, no upgrade, downgrade, outlook change, sustained breach or instrument notch is inferred. This is an analytical hold, not a finding of issuer distress, rating stability or absence of ratings. Restore the forecast dependency and dated agency evidence before relying on migration conclusions.

### Rating transition view

**The accepted-forecast gate fails independently of the ratings-evidence gap.** CP-2G explicitly records a failed mandatory downside dependency and no forecast computation. Its historical inputs and interface calendar do not constitute base, upside or downside observations. CP-2 is now present, but that does not retrospectively change CP-2A or CP-2G into accepted analytical producers. The affected owners must rerun rather than this module silently constructing a forecast.

The source-readiness handoff separately records conditional ratings readiness. Context page:1 contains an empty ratings list; this establishes absent user inputs, not the issuer's rating status. No agency-issued or management-reported rating is adopted. Missing current rating evidence can permit methodology-only work under the method, but does not override a failed mandatory upstream dependency. No methodology mapping is claimed here because applicable dated criteria are also absent.

### Strongest contrary case and what would change the decision

The strongest case for proceeding is the available historical financial foundation and bounded fundamental synthesis. They can identify questions about cash retention, financial policy, earnings definitions and liquidity. They cannot establish which agency factors apply, how that agency adjusts debt and earnings, or whether a stated condition must persist across reporting periods. Treating those questions as published agency triggers would create false precision and unattributed conclusions.

That case would prevail after a current accepted forecast is supplied and dated agency evidence establishes the legal rated entity, rating type, action date, criteria, trigger definitions and required observation window. This module could then bridge the existing financial definitions instead of re-extracting or inventing them. Until then, confidence in migration direction is Not assessable; confidence in the documented input failure is High. Downstream implementation is to withhold migration-dependent conclusions, not assume neutral pressure.

### Downside causality and timing boundary

No issuer-specific rating downside chain is accepted after the dependency gate fails. A supported chain would need an evidenced initiating condition, first operating break, cash/earnings transmission, agency-defined leverage or liquidity consequence, and dated review catalyst. The current blocked forecast cannot supply their magnitude or timing. Consequently neither a cash exhaustion date nor a rating review date, sustained leverage breach or refinancing-driven downgrade catalyst is established here. Restoring workflow inputs is a control event, not an issuer rating catalyst.

## Calculations

No new arithmetic was performed; no calculate call was necessary because there are no accepted trigger operands. Historical financial ratios were not retyped into an agency case. No signed headroom, range-bound distance, leverage bridge, sustained-breach test, probability or numerical confidence score was hand-derived.

On rerun, headroom must use agency-defined numerator, denominator, direction and period. Maximum-ratio and minimum-ratio headroom cannot share an unexamined sign convention. A sustained trigger requires the agency's actual ordered observation window and matching periods within a single case; repeated scenarios at one date do not establish duration. These are calculation controls, not completed tests.

The inherited financial foundation distinguishes carrying debt from gross principal and reported earnings from management-adjusted earnings. Neither basis is selected as an agency definition here. No covenant capacity, one-off normalization or non-debt funding adjustment is inferred; trade payables are not relabeled financing float. Missing values are not zero.
